patterns: Avengers: Doomsday one month out took the feed: 21 hits drew 18,001,450 views. DiscussingFilm's 'new look at the cast' led the day at 5,067,623 and the Nightcrawler first look did 4,379,428.
Stills beat trailers: 14 'first look / new look' posts drew 15,380,795 views vs 10,155,030 for 12 trailer posts. A single clean image plus a character name is the strongest hook right now.
Gaming crossover stayed huge on GTA 6 launch day: 10 game posts drew 8,091,682, and the oddball 'Being a furry is illegal in GTA 6' did 2,512,976 with 108,851 likes.
Real-life tech drama on screen: Guadagnino's ARTIFICIAL (Andrew Garfield as Sam Altman, Ike Barinholtz as Elon Musk) put 6 posts over 5K for 5,512,329 views.

Re-release and ranking bait drive likes: 'Project Hail Mary returning to theaters in IMAX and 70mm' had the day's most likes (155,067 on 2,961,228 views), and Variety's 100 Greatest Movie Stars list was FilmUpdates' best at 1,969,562.
Small accounts win with blunt opinions: CinemaTweets1's one-word-verdict pan of Madden ('dishonor') did 257,743, more than double its next post (104,238).
narrative_synthesis: Doomsday's one-month push and stills-first marketing dominated; GTA 6 launch kept gaming in the film feed; AI-on-screen (ARTIFICIAL) is a fresh lane that fits Cinema's AI Aftermaths book.
